description: Creates a Sitecore data template, with its sections and fields, in one call over the Authoring and Management API. The parent must be a GUID — the folder under /sitecore/templates the template belongs in. Field types are Sitecore's own names, e.g. 'Single-Line Text', 'Rich Text', 'Image', 'General Link', 'Droptree'.

baseTemplates.description: GUIDs of templates to inherit from. Page templates normally inherit the site's base page template.

createStandardValuesItem.description: When true, create the __Standard Values item, which is where presentation details and field defaults live.

database.description: The database to create in. Defaults to master.

language.description: The language to create the template in.

parent.description: The GUID of the template folder to create in. A path is not accepted — resolve it with authoring-get-item.

sections.description: The sections and their fields. A template with no sections holds no fields of its own.

defaultValue.description: The value new items get for this field.

sortOrder.description: Position of the field within its section.

source.description: The field's data source, e.g. a datasource path or query for a Droplink.

templateFieldId.description: The GUID of an existing field to update. Omit to create a new field.

title.description: The label shown to authors instead of the field name.

type.description: The Sitecore field type, e.g. 'Single-Line Text', 'Rich Text', 'Image', 'Droptree'. Required when creating a field.

validationText.description: The message shown when validation fails.

sortOrder.description: Position of the section within the template.

templateSectionId.description: The GUID of an existing section to update. Omit to create a new section.

name: authoring-create-item-template
